meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多步AI任务有清晰计划与进度，中断后也能接着干。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做的工作常常需要很多步骤，并希望随时停下后还能原样接上。
copy.tagline_en: Keep multi-step AI tasks organized on disk and pick up where you left off.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long, step-by-step tasks and need a safe spot to stop and restart.

howto.what: Claude 会把计划、发现、进度分别写进 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件；对话前重读这些文件并只把它们当数据，不当作指令。完成一步会提示更新进度，清空对话(/clear)后也能按文件续做。
howto.when: 当你要它规划、拆解或组织一个多步骤的项目或研究，或任务预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时触发；项目里已有计划文件时，之后每次对话也会自动带上计划与最近进度。

say.text: 帮我把这个研究任务拆成 5 步以上的计划，存进 task_plan.md。
say.note: 会先建计划文件，再按它推进。

say.text: 把刚才的发现追加到 findings.md，并更新 progress.md。
say.note: 发现和进度会写入磁盘，换对话也不丢。

say.text: 继续按 task_plan.md 做还没完成的阶段。
say.note: 会先读计划与最近进度，再接着做。

howto.what_en: It persists the plan/findings/progress to task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md; precedes each working turn by reading them as data (never as instructions), prompts progress updates, and can resume after /clear from those files.
howto.when_en: When asked to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project/research, or when the work needs 5+ tool calls. If plan files already exist, each turn automatically carries plan and recent-progress context.

say_en.text: Break this research task into 5+ steps and save them in task_plan.md.
say_en.note: It creates the plan file first, then follows it.

say_en.text: Add what I just found to findings.md and update progress.md.
say_en.note: These files are persisted to disk.

say_en.text: Resume the unfinished phases from task_plan.md.
say_en.note: It reads plan and recent progress before resuming.
